vulnerability.name: CVE-2025-60876
vulnerability.description: BusyBox wget through 1.37.0 accepts raw CR/LF and C0 control bytes in HTTP request-target, allowing request line splitting and header injection via crafted URLs.

statements.impact_statement: The BusyBox wget applet is never invoked in these images. The base image installs the standalone wget package (APK: wget), which shadows the BusyBox applet in PATH. No entrypoint script, build step, or runtime process in any image layer uses wget — all HTTP operations use curl. The BusyBox binary cannot be removed as it is Alpine's coreutils provider, but the vulnerable wget applet within it is unreachable.
